source_licence_note: Official Environment Agency/Defra, OGC, GDAL/OSGeo and PROJ documentation; publisher terms apply.

official_sources.title: EA 1 m DTM service and survey-index access surfaces
official_sources.finding: The official 1 m DTM page exposes native survey download, survey coverage metadata, survey-index WMS/WFS, DTM WCS and WMTS plus OGC API access; target sampling must bind the chosen retrieval route and survey-index lineage rather than infer values from rendered services.
official_sources.limitation: Service availability and product metadata do not themselves provide the target parcel elevation.

official_sources.title: OGC Web Coverage Service standard
official_sources.finding: WCS is the OGC standard for electronic retrieval of geospatial coverages; core requirements define coverage access while extensions separately govern CRS, scaling, interpolation, range subsetting and encodings.
official_sources.limitation: A standards-compliant request can still be scaled or transformed; exact target-grid provenance must be recorded.

official_sources.title: OGC API Coverages draft model
official_sources.finding: OGC API Coverages models coverage access through collections with declared CRS, extent, schema and coverage resources; self-describing domain/range metadata must accompany numeric coverage values.
official_sources.limitation: This specification is still draft and cannot replace the stable native source when exact reproducibility requires it.

official_sources.title: GDAL WCS raster driver
official_sources.finding: GDAL WCS can issue capabilities, DescribeCoverage and GetCoverage requests and exposes controls for coverage, format, interpolation, domain axes, nodata, block sizing and time dimensions.
official_sources.limitation: Driver defaults may select formats, overviews or request behavior unless explicitly pinned.

official_sources.title: GDAL WCS axis and grid-geometry quirks
official_sources.finding: GDAL documents WCS options for origin-at-boundary, outer extents, grid offsets and axis swapping, proving that server/client grid interpretation can differ and must be frozen in the request ledger.
official_sources.limitation: These compatibility switches are server-specific; enabling one without evidence can itself corrupt cell addressing.

official_sources.title: PROJ pipeline operator
official_sources.finding: PROJ transformation pipelines serialize multiple coordinate operations in order, require compatible units between steps and can explicitly include grid shifts, axis swaps and unit conversions.
official_sources.limitation: A syntactically valid pipeline is not automatically the authoritative operation for the target area.

official_sources.title: PROJ vertical grid shift
official_sources.finding: PROJ vertical grid shifts apply values from named grids, support multiple prioritized grids and epoch controls, and treat grids prefixed with @ as optional when missing.
official_sources.limitation: Optional missing grids are unacceptable for fail-closed high-accuracy replay unless absence is explicitly allowed by the authoritative operation.

official_sources.title: PROJ projinfo operation selection controls
official_sources.finding: projinfo can restrict operations by area/bbox, hide ballpark transformations and require a desired accuracy, exposing operation names, stated accuracy and area of use for reproducible selection.
official_sources.limitation: Reported operation accuracy is metadata and does not replace source-survey vertical accuracy.

official_sources.title: PROJ runtime operation and grid availability API
official_sources.finding: PROJ exposes coordinate-operation accuracy and required-grid availability; since PROJ 9.1 vertical transformations are only applied when source and target are 3D or compound CRS with a vertical component.
official_sources.limitation: Runtime database/version and grid-package state must be recorded because operation availability can change.

official_sources.title: PROJ computation of operations between CRS
official_sources.finding: PROJ filters coordinate operations by desired accuracy, area of use and required-grid availability and ranks non-ballpark, implementable operations ahead of weaker alternatives.
official_sources.limitation: Automatic ranking must be checked against the authoritative UK transformation requirement rather than accepted blindly.

official_sources.title: PROJ axis swap conversion
official_sources.finding: PROJ axis swap explicitly changes coordinate axis order and sign; any implicit or explicit swap must therefore be serialized in the transformation ledger before raster addressing.
official_sources.limitation: Axis order correctness depends on the source/target CRS and API convention actually used.

official_sources.title: PROJ horizontal grid shift
official_sources.finding: PROJ horizontal grid shift uses prioritized named grids and optional-grid syntax; grid identity and precedence affect transformed coordinates and must be captured for replay.
official_sources.limitation: Horizontal grid correctness does not prove the vertical datum or target raster lineage.
